title: 第七章 金线白鳞鱼第八章 武馆拜师
slug: 从白猿拳破限开始成就人间武圣
content_zh:
水底下，苏羽靠着碧波鱼骨功，在河水中急速穿梭。
即使水域地形复杂，水下乱石嶙峋，他依然游动飞快，好不自在。
这碧波鱼骨功，直接让他的水下能力提升了一大截！
而且在水下他的鱼骨功明显肝的更快了。
【熟练度+1】
【熟练度+1】
……
【武学】：碧波鱼骨功（入门15100）
“若是突破到熟练，这鱼骨功不知道能提升到什么程度。那时，即使是黑水河深处的激流，也大可去得！”苏羽对这鱼骨功越发期待了。
就在这时，幽暗的前方突然闪过一道奇异的亮光。
苏羽瞳孔微缩，定睛瞧去。
只见一条体长足有两尺的大鱼正从岩缝中游出，通体雪白，唯有背脊上一条金线熠熠生辉，在昏暗的水底映照出一抹金光。
“好家伙！金线白鳞鱼！”
苏羽呼吸一滞，心脏猛地跳动起来。
金线白鳞鱼，白鳞鱼中的异种，虽不是宝鱼，价值也远超普通白鳞鱼。
这么一条，足以价值数两银子！
那金线白鳞鱼极为机警，感知道水流异动，尾鳍猛地一拍，化作一道白光激射而出。
“想跑？”
若是以往，苏羽肯定追不上，不过如今他有了鱼骨功！
脊椎发力，他在水中一个丝滑的折返，瞬间加速，死死咬住那道白光。

一追一逃，两侧的礁石水草如浮光掠影般倒退。
俄顷，那白鱼似是被追急了，猛地一头扎进了一片茂密得如同墙壁的水草丛中，消失在一处高耸出水的断崖之下。
苏羽急停，浮出水面换了一大口气。
“这下面难道有洞？”
河水冰寒刺骨，体内的热量在飞速流逝。但他顾不得这些，深吸一口气，再次潜入水底。
扒开那厚重的水草墙，一个宽阔幽深的水下洞口赫然显现。
苏羽咬了咬牙，身形一动，施展分水游，如泥鳅般钻了进去。
穿过一段狭长压抑的水道，眼前豁然开朗。
苏羽猛地浮出水面，大口喘息，观察着里面的情况。
这是一个半水半旱的天然溶洞。
两头是深不见底的水坑，中间是一方干燥宽阔的石台，足可容纳数十人。头顶上方极高处，有一线天光洒落，隐约可见数百丈高的崖壁裂缝，空气流通，并无憋闷之感。
“好地方！”
content_en:
Under the water, Su Yu relied on the Blue Wave Fish Bone Technique to quickly shuttle through the river.
Even though the water surface was complex and the underwater rocks were rugged, he still swam so fast that he felt uncomfortable.
This Blue Wave Fish Bone Technique directly improved his underwater ability by a large margin!
Moreover, his fish bone skills obviously improved faster underwater.
[Proficiency +1]
[Proficiency +1]
…
[Martial Arts]: Bibo Fish Bone Kung Fu (Introduction 15100)
"If you break through to proficiency, I don't know how far this Fish Bone Technique can be improved. By then, you can even go to the rapids in the depths of the Blackwater River!" Su Yu was looking forward to this Fish Bone Technique more and more.
At this moment, a strange light suddenly flashed in the dark front.
Su Yu's pupils narrowed and he looked intently.
I saw a big fish with a body length of two feet swimming out from the crack in the rock. It was all white except for a golden line on its back, which reflected a golden light in the dim water.
"Good guy! Golden-threaded white-scaled fish!"
Su Yu's breathing was stagnant, and his heart beat violently.
Golden-threaded white-scaled fish is a different species of white-scaled fish. Although it is not a treasure fish, its value is far higher than that of ordinary white-scaled fish.
Such a piece is worth several taels of silver!
The golden-threaded white-scaled fish was extremely alert. It sensed the abnormal movement of the water flow and flapped its tail fin suddenly, turning into a white light and shooting out.
"Want to run?"
If it were in the past, Su Yu would definitely not be able to catch up, but now he has the fish bone skill!
Using his spine, he made a silky turn in the water, accelerated instantly, and clung to the white light.
After chasing and escaping, the reef aquatic plants on both sides retreated like a fleeting glimpse of light.
After a while, the white fish seemed to be chased urgently, and it plunged into a thick patch of water grass that was as dense as a wall, and disappeared under a towering cliff above the water.
Su Yu stopped suddenly, surfaced and took a deep breath.
"Is there a hole down here?"
The water in the river was freezing cold, and the heat in the body was draining away rapidly. But he didn't care about this, took a deep breath, and dived into the water again.
After peeling back the thick wall of water plants, a wide and deep underwater cave suddenly appeared.
Su Yu gritted his teeth, moved his body, used Water Dividing Swim, and got in like a loach.
After passing through a long, narrow and depressing waterway, the vision suddenly opened up.
Su Yu suddenly emerged from the water, gasping for breath, and observed the situation inside.
This is a half-water and half-arid natural cave.
There are bottomless puddles at both ends, and in the middle is a dry and wide stone platform that can accommodate dozens of people. Very high above the head, there is a ray of skylight falling, and the cracks in the cliff hundreds of feet high can be vaguely seen. The air is flowing, and there is no feeling of suffocation.
“Great place!”
